changelog:
Initial major release with comprehensive competitor SEO & GEO analysis capabilities.

- Identifies and analyzes competitor keyword rankings, content strategies, backlink profiles, and GEO (AI citation) approaches.
- Reveals actionable opportunities to outperform competitors and close market gaps.
- Offers guided frameworks for identifying competitors by type.
- Provides detailed analysis procedures: keyword, content, backlinks, technical, and AI/GEO presence.
- Includes scenario-based instructions and data requirements for automated or manual use.
- Supports integration with SEO and analytics tools, as well as manual competitor data input.
